question: After the credential copy and live-proof requirements are satisfied, should this clean standalone PR become the canonical AnyRouter landing path instead of https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2171?
rationale: Both open PRs carry substantially the same provider implementation, but this branch has the corrected management-key direction and clean checks while neither currently has sufficient live proof.

options.title: Use this standalone PR
options.body: Treat this PR as canonical after its remaining Settings copy defect and live-proof gate are resolved, then close the older conflicting PR.

options.title: Return changes to the original PR
options.body: Move the corrected credential contract back to https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2171 and close this standalone branch once the original is clean and proven.

recommendation.title: Use this standalone PR
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as canonical after its remaining Settings copy defect and live-proof gate are resolved, then close the older conflicting PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available person to choose the canonical landing branch for overlapping provider contributions.
